quarterly_data.signal: ACM Shanghai's August 14, 2026 investor-relations record (Exhibit 99.1) gives delivery timing for its 2026 horizontal panel-level electroplating orders: the first 510 × 515 mm volume-production system (existing advanced packaging customer in mainland China) is planned for delivery in the first quarter of 2027, and the 310 × 310 mm evaluation system (leading panel packaging customer in Asia) by the end of 2026. The technology supports 310 × 310 mm, 510 × 515 mm and 600 × 600 mm panels.
quarterly_data.figure: 510 × 515 mm volume-production system: delivery Q1 2027; 310 × 310 mm evaluation system: delivery by end of 2026; 600 × 600 mm panels also supported

quarterly_data.signal: ACM Shanghai's atmospheric-pressure oxidation and LPCVD furnaces have gradually been adopted by multiple integrated circuit manufacturers in China and are progressing through customer qualification toward higher order volumes; several ALD furnace products are being introduced to customers for qualification, with certain processes having completed small-batch validation.
